column1: Special Case 4: The IS–LM Model Suppose that a is infinite and CF(r – r∗) 5 0. In this case, the short-run aggregate supply curve is horizontal, and there are no international capital flows. For any given level of expected inflation Ep, the level of income and interest rate must adjust to equilibrate the goods market and the money market. This special case corresponds to the economy analyzed in Chapters 11 and 12.
